title: tuipresent deck front matter
description: The YAML block between the opening '---' (first line of the file) and the next line that is exactly '---'. Mirrors deck.Meta in internal/deck/deck.go and the theme keys in internal/render/theme.go; internal/docscheck fails if they drift apart. Unknown keys are ignored by the parser, so additionalProperties is true. See docs/agent/LANGUAGE.md sections 2 and 18.

title.description: Deck title. When non-empty, a cover slide is inserted as slide 1 and the title appears in the footer.

sub_title.description: Italic line on the cover slide. Only shown when title is set (the cover exists only then).

author.description: Shown on the cover and in the footer as 'title  ·  author'.

date.description: Shown on the cover after the author as 'author  ·  date'. Free text; not parsed as a date.

theme.description: Color theme: a built-in name (or alias), or a mapping. Unknown names render in 'dark' with a warning. Run 'tuipresent -themes' for the list.

transition.description: Default transition into every slide. The parser lowercases and trims the value; anything else acts as 'slide' and produces a warning. This schema only allows the five meaningful values so typos are caught.

fade.description: Pause-reveal fade for the whole deck. Disabled by false or by the strings 'false', 'off', 'no', 'none' (case-insensitive); any other value, or absence, leaves it on. A slide's <!-- fade: ... --> directive overrides it, and the -fade=false flag overrides both.

text.description: Any YAML scalar is accepted and used as its text (123 becomes "123"). Write a string. Sequences and mappings are a load error.

themeName.description: A built-in theme name or alias, matched case-insensitively. Other strings are accepted by the parser but fall back to 'dark' with a warning.

color.description: A hex color, #rgb or #rrggbb. Quote it in YAML: a bare # starts a comment and leaves the value empty, which is a load error.

themeObject.description: Theme mapping. Palette keys override colors of the theme chosen by name or path. Other keys (including 'extends', which only works in theme files) are ignored with a warning.

path.description: Custom theme file (YAML with optional 'extends' plus palette keys), relative to the deck file. Wins over name (with a warning if both are set).

background.description: Painting mode, not a color: 'terminal' draws on the terminal's own background, 'paint' paints the theme background and foreground into every cell. Other values warn and mean 'terminal'. Set the background color in a theme file.

accent.description: Title gradient start, rules, progress bar, status line; default for heading, link and bullet.

accent2.description: Title gradient end; default for subheading and code.

bullet.description: List bullets and numbers. Default: accent.

code_background.description: Inline code and code-block panels. Default: background mixed 8% toward foreground.

quote.description: Blockquote text and bar. Default: dim.

border.description: Table borders and horizontal rules. Default: dim.

code_style.description: Chroma syntax-highlighting style name, e.g. monokai. Unknown names warn and keep the base theme's style.
